title: Lixity | Local manuscript analysis and revision
description: Lixity is a local app for writing, reviewing and revising manuscripts. Compare drafts and keep your sources beside the text.
example_finding: In one sentence from the demo, Lixity counts 31 words, including 22 function words.
headline: A workspace for your manuscript
intro: Write and compare drafts, see why a passage was marked, and trace a decision back to its source. Lixity brings that work together on your computer.
demo_note: Change a sample paragraph in the browser exercise and see which counts change.
preview: Lixity showing the opening chapter of The Crate at Warehouse 4 beside the project navigation.
tasks_title: What you can do with Lixity
read_text: Edit your manuscript in the writing workspace. Compare your current draft with the last saved version to see what changed.
research_text: Link sources and character dossiers to passages in the manuscript. Open the saved source version as you read.
research_case_link: Follow the receipt in the demo guide
share_text: Export a saved dossier as a PDF with passages and source quotations. You can also make a reading site with selected chapters and background notes.
audio_text: Record yourself reading in the teleprompter. With a speech service configured, preview one paragraph in the selected voice before rendering a chapter.
principle_text: A mark shows what Lixity counted. Read the passage in context and decide if the long sentence or repetition fits the scene.
start_text: Download the desktop preview for your computer, or install the published local browser app from your terminal.
scope: The Warehouse 4 demo and film show development version v{version}.
languages_text: The website and app interface are available in seven languages. Manuscript analysis is separate: English is the default unless you select another profile explicitly, and technical documentation remains in English.
limits: Language-dependent analysis coverage varies by language and is deepest for German and English. Switching the interface language never alters your manuscript.
feedback_text: Tell us what you wanted to do and where you got stuck. A few steps or a fictional example are enough.
linguistics_text: Compare sentence rhythm, word choice and quoted words across chapters. Open the passages behind a measurement to see what Lixity counted.
tour_title: The blank line | Lixity in {tour_duration} seconds
tour_note: Silent film. The captions appear below the video.
film_context: Follow a sentence from the manuscript to the records behind the scene.
tour_receipt: Can Mara sign for an arrival she never saw?
tour_read: Mara places the torn edges of two forms together. They don’t match.
tour_revision: Lixity counts 22 function words. The unsaved draft takes the sentence from 31 words to 12.
tour_dossier: The ledger records a return at 18:40. The receipt records a dispatch at 20:00. Both carry the number 17.
tour_decision: Mara signs her account of what she entered. The receiving line on the receipt stays blank.
tour_pdf: The author exports the exhibit book as a PDF. The saved version number appears below the title.
tour_error: The video could not load. Explore the interactive demo instead.
sandbox_cta: Try a passage in the browser
answer_marks: You can review sentence lengths, recognized quotations and repeated words in the text and compare chapters.
answer_local: Your project files stay on your computer, where the built-in analysis runs. Optional services such as maps and external language models have their own data requirements.
question_demo: What can I try in the browser?
answer_demo: Use the browser exercise to edit an example paragraph. The read-only Warehouse 4 demo lets you inspect a whole manuscript and its research. Install Lixity to edit, analyse and export your own project.
tour_share_vertical: Download the {tour_duration}-second tour in portrait format
tour_share_horizontal: Download the {tour_duration}-second tour in landscape format
funding_summary: Early contributions help sign the desktop installers and develop Lixity for Android and iOS.
